articles.title: Trump plans to take Qatari jet to Asia, but it’s unclear whether it’s been ‘maxed out’
articles.description: President Donald Trump is expected to take the Qatari-gifted Air Force One to Asia on Monday as questions linger about upgrades the White House said were needed after a security threat from Iran forced the president to fly home from Turkey on a secret military plane in July, according to two U.S. officials.
